description: Use this when the user wants to find a home in Slovakia — a flat, house, cottage or building plot for sale or for rent — by type, rooms, place (town, Bratislava/Košice borough, district or region), price, area, floor, condition or amenities (balcony, lift, parking, cellar). Covers listings agencies and owners published on LivinIsto directly and public listings from Slovak property portals. Pass the criteria as ONE short phrase in Slovak, with numbers as the user said them. Sale is the default; for rent write "prenájom". Examples that are fully understood: "2-izbový byt Žilina do 180000 €", "prenájom 1-izbový byt Bratislava do 700 €", "rodinný dom okres Senec do 350000 €", "pozemok Trnava od 600 m2". Words the rules do not recognise are searched in the listing text (at most 6); words that were not applied (too short, beyond that limit, impressions like lacný or pekný, unmet negations like "bez záhrady", places abroad) are listed in notUnderstood. Returns up to 10 properties with price, price per m² and price verdict, LivinIsto's own summary sentence, what was understood, which criteria were relaxed when nothing matched exactly, and a link to all results. Limits: only properties currently listed on LivinIsto in Slovakia (no property abroad, no commercial premises, no short holiday stays); prices in EUR, rents per month; asking prices, not sale prices; a listing may already be sold.

query.description: Concrete criteria in Slovak, e.g. "2-izbový byt Žilina do 180000 €" or "prenájom 1-izbový byt Bratislava do 700 €".

name: search_properties

notUnderstood.description: Words from the query that were NOT applied (too short, unmet negation, impression words like lacný, place abroad, words not found in any listing). Empty together with empty relaxed = the results match everything in the query.

properties.description: Up to 10 properties in LivinIsto's order.

areaM2.description: Floor area in m²; null when not stated.

cityPart.description: Borough of Bratislava or Košice, when known.

comparableListings.description: How many comparable listings the saving is computed from.

floor.description: Floor (0 = ground floor); null when not stated.

id.description: Stable LivinIsto property id; pass it to get_property_details.

landAreaM2.description: Plot area in m²; null when not stated.

priceEur.description: Asking price in EUR (per month for rent). null = the number in the ad is NOT the price of the whole property — see priceNote; never quote one.

priceIsMonthly.description: True for rent: priceEur and pricePerM2Eur are per month.

priceNote.description: Why the price is missing or what it means (co-ownership share, auction, room only…), in Slovak. Tell the user.

pricePerM2Eur.description: Asking price per m² of floor area (or of the plot for pozemok); null when area or price is unknown or not real.

priceSavingPerM2Eur.description: EUR per m² below the median of comparable listings; only set when priceVerdict is below_market.

priceVerdict.description: LivinIsto price verdict per m² against comparable properties (same type, place, rooms or size). null = not enough comparable listings, too dispersed, or the price is not a plain price.

propertyType.description: byt = flat, dom = house, chata = cottage / holiday home, pozemok = building plot, apartman = apartment.

reserved.description: The source marks it as reserved.

roomOnly.description: True when the rent is for a room in a shared flat, not the whole flat.

rooms.description: Number of rooms; null when not stated (or when only a room is rented).

source.description: Where the listing comes from (portal name, or LivinIsto for a listing published on LivinIsto directly).

title.description: What it is and where, assembled by LivinIsto (e.g. "2-izbový byt, Žilina · Vlčince") — never the seller's own headline.

url.description: Link to the property on www.livinisto.sk — show it to the user unchanged.

relaxed.description: Criteria dropped because nothing matched exactly.

summary.description: LivinIsto's own sentence about the result (what was found, where, what was relaxed), in Slovak.

totalMatches.description: How many properties in the offer match (after relaxing, if any).

understood.description: Filters LivinIsto applied, in Slovak (e.g. byt, 2-izbový, Žilina, do 180 000 €, predaj).

title: Search properties
